tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: List the software price categories of the Shortlist Price Index that are current: entry prices (lowest paid plan per provider) for US/global categories in USD and Dutch categories in EUR, each with the date of its latest update. Returns slugs to use with get_price_index, get_cheapest and get_true_3y

tools.name: get_price_index
tools.description: Get the full current price index for one category: average, median and cheapest entry price, every tracked provider with its current price, rating and best-for note (sorted cheapest first), monthly history and methodology. tools.name: get_true_3yr_cost
tools.description: The honest 3-year cost per provider: year 1 at the intro or first-year price, years 2 and 3 at the published renewal price, ranked by real 3-year total. Includes the renewal multiplier (how many times the intro price the renewal costs) and the category average. The cheapest intro is rarely the cheap

tools.name: get_cheapest
tools.description: Get the N cheapest providers in a category with current entry prices, ratings and best-for notes, plus a link to the full comparison. findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "get_cheapest" references sensitive artifacts (password). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Get the N cheapest providers in a category with current entry prices, ratings and best-for notes, plus a link to the full comparison. Ideal for quick recommenda…

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "list_categories" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "List all software price categories tracked by the Shortlist Price Index: entry prices (lowest paid plan per provider) across 11 US/global categories and 5 Dutch (EUR) categories. Returns slugs to use with get_price_index and get_cheapest." → after: "List the software price categories of the Shortlist Price Index that are current: entry prices (lowest paid plan per provider) for US/global categories in USD and Dutch categories in EUR, each with the date of its latest update. Returns slugs to use with get_price_index, get_cheapest and get_true_3y"

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
